classification.difficultyReason: Expand quadratic products and match coefficients, including zero coefficients. Parts d and e require retaining both square-root signs and pairing each parameter value with its corresponding second unknown.

content.prompt: Find the missing values by equating coefficients.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}x^2-2x-24+ax+b&=x^2+8x-25\\x^2+(a-2)x+(b-24)&=x^2+8x-25\end{aligned}$$
Equating coefficients of $x$ and constant terms:
$$\begin{aligned}a-2&=8,&b-24&=-25\\a&=10,&b&=-1\end{aligned}$$

$$\begin{aligned}4x^2-24x+35+ax^2+b&=3x^2-24x+12\\(4+a)x^2-24x+(35+b)&=3x^2-24x+12\end{aligned}$$
Equating coefficients of $x^2$ and constant terms:
$$\begin{aligned}4+a&=3,&35+b&=12\\a&=-1,&b&=-23\end{aligned}$$

$$\begin{aligned}x^2-4x+4+x+ax+ab&=x^2+1\\x^2+(a-3)x+(4+ab)&=x^2+1\end{aligned}$$
Equating coefficients of $x$ and constant terms:
$$\begin{aligned}a-3&=0,&4+ab&=1\\a&=3,&4+3b&=1\\&&3b&=-3\\&&b&=-1\end{aligned}$$

$$\begin{aligned}x^2+2bx+b^2&=x^2+cx+49\end{aligned}$$
Equating coefficients of $x$ and constant terms:
$$\begin{aligned}2b&=c,&b^2&=49\\&&b&=\pm7\end{aligned}$$
If $b=7$:
$$\begin{aligned}c&=2(7)\\&=14\end{aligned}$$
If $b=-7$:
$$\begin{aligned}c&=2(-7)\\&=-14\end{aligned}$$

$$\begin{aligned}x^2+3cx+2c^2&=x^2+dx+50\end{aligned}$$
Equating coefficients of $x$ and constant terms:
$$\begin{aligned}3c&=d,&2c^2&=50\\&&c^2&=25\\&&c&=\pm5\end{aligned}$$
If $c=5$:
$$\begin{aligned}d&=3(5)\\&=15\end{aligned}$$
If $c=-5$:
$$\begin{aligned}d&=3(-5)\\&=-15\end{aligned}$$
